question.text: For designated persons who are connected persons of a mutual fund/AMC/trustees, the contra trade restriction period for dealing in units of mutual funds shall not be less than:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Schedule C, the contra trade restriction for a Designated Person connected with a mutual fund, AMC, or trustees dealing in mutual fund units shall not be less than two months. The Trap: Six months is the general contra trade restriction for securities, but a shorter two-month period applies specifically to mutual fund units. Note: Per NISM-III-C (Securities Intermediaries Compliance - Fund) workbook (p.130 Schedule C; reiterated at p.266).
